response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY original_language_id) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_group_avg_rate, AVG(n) AS avg_of_group_film_count FROM g

assumptions.assumption: '5 days as the cutoff for a long allowed rental period' is read as rental_duration >= 5 (5 days itself counts as long). NULL original_language_id forms its own group via GROUP BY, which keeps NULLs together as one group.

alternatives.interpretation: Long rental period means strictly more than 5 days (rental_duration > 5).
